leads.name: Pollok Beech (the Wishing Tree), Pollok Country Park
leads.approx_location: behind Pollok House, Pollok Country Park (no coordinate fetched)
leads.reason: alive status unproven and sources conflict. Friends of Glasgow Botanic Gardens (2018-04-06): about 250 years old, burned out by vandals about 2017, split in two, sparse new growth, cuttings taken. Glasgow City Council Pollok heritage trail (via search summary, PDF 403): blew down in the March 1982 gales and lives on from a layered branch. No report from 2019 onward found. Wikipedia: 7 m girth at grade, thought 250 years old. Needs a dated recent photo or council statement, plus a pin; lifecheck NONE at a guessed coordinate.

leads.name: Pollok Park veteran parkland trees (Deerpark, Driplea) and Pollok Beech mound
leads.approx_location: Pollok Country Park: Deerpark and Driplea grazed parks, woodland garden east of Pollok House
leads.reason: HES inventory GDL00317 says veteran parkland trees survive as individuals, roundels and a copse in Deerpark and Driplea, and the Pollok Beech stands on a mound in the woodland garden east of the house; no girths or individual trees named. Beggar's Tree blew down 1982. Pollok Beech lead above stays unresolved.
